consts.name: dczWaterBreathDivisor
consts.comment: the drowning hazard: an unprotected character holds his breath for 1/3 his Constitution score (rounded up) in rounds; potions and spells of water breathing, the ring without a time limit, or polymorph to a water-breather carry the traveler.

consts.name: dczWaterVisionFeet
consts.comment: the clearest water reduces sighting distance to 60 feet maximum; the varying temperature renders infravision no better than normal vision; sounds carry greater distances.

consts.name: dczWaterEncounterDenom
consts.comment: travelers have a 1-in-10 chance of an encounter every four hours; roll: 1-10 elemental phenomena, 11-25 elemental pocket, 26-00 creature encounter.

consts.name: dczWaterPhenomenaDieSides
consts.comment: the d12 phenomena: steam current (1-3), whirlpool (4-5), ice floe (6-8), tidal bore, silt flow, the airy water pocket, and the vortex to a Prime Material plane.

consts.name: dczWaterPocketTableDie
consts.comment: the d20 pocket table: air 1-3, earth 4-6, ice 7-9, ooze 10-12, salt 13-14, steam 15-16, and the rare hostile fire/magma only at 20 - the airy-water survival rule governs them.

consts.name: dczWaterChartDieSides
consts.comment: the Water encounter chart is a d8+d12 roll (2-20): 2 the Charonadaemon, 9 the water elementals, 10 the marids, 11 the tritons, 20 the eye of the deep - the 2 and 20 unique-powers slots.

consts.name: dczWaterNativeFireDouble
consts.comment: the native vulnerability: all fire attacks on water elemental creatures inflict double damage with a -4 saving throw penalty (within the plane's fire limitations); natives are less susceptible to cold, earth and air attacks than Prime creatures.

bools.name: dczWaterOceanDoctrine
bools.comment: the ocean without a surface: pressure uniform in all directions like a few feet beneath a Prime ocean, soft glowing blues and greens radiating from the water itself - less harsh than Fire and Earth, less accessible than Air.

bools.name: dczWaterBordersGrade
bools.comment: the border gradations: muck toward Ooze, chill ice fragments toward Ice, warm agitation toward Steam, evaporating brine toward Salt.

bools.name: dczWaterSwimDouble
bools.comment: swimming creatures move at twice their normal rate in the plane of elemental Water.

bools.name: dczWaterCombatRules
bools.comment: underwater combat per the DMG p. 56 limitations; nets entangle but cannot drag to a sea floor that does not exist; crossbows need magical bolts (normal bolts hang motionless once fired).

bools.name: dczWaterMagicRule
bools.comment: spells are affected as in Prime seas (DMG 57, UA 81) - a fireball is useless from the water itself but works in an air pocket; contact other plane makes silvery cabbage-sized balls; summonings make charmed golden-green spheres.

bools.name: dczWaterMaridHousehold
bools.comment: the marids: the handsomest, most powerful, most chaotic geniekind - a loose empire under a padisha, households of 2d10 around pocket clusters; nearly unsummonable (more trouble than worth, hence no marid-controlling items).
